formHeader.title: Edit handover package
formHeader.description: Update the details for this handover package.

help.title: About editing a handover package
help.overview: You are editing a checklist configuration. Project, edifice, floor, and unit are locked. Changing items here updates open sales; sales that already have a title-transfer date stay frozen.

sections.title: What you can change
items: Title, description, notes, attachments, and the checklist items (name, description, instructions, importance).
Scope fields stay read-only. To apply the same ideas at another level, create a separate package there.

sections.title: Adding or removing items
items: New items appear on open sales as unchecked rows, labeled with this package’s scope.
Remove an incomplete item and it drops from open sales.
Remove a completed item and the sale keeps it as retained. Retained rows cannot be unticked and never block title transfer.
Add the same name back at this same scope and a retained row re-attaches with its tick kept.

sections.title: Frozen sales
items: Once a sale has a title-transfer date, its checklist snapshot does not change when you edit this config.
Later edits only affect sales that are still open.

sections.title: Where ticking happens
items: Use Sales → Update handover. This page does not record completion.
